title: Practical Magic 2
synopsis: Starring Sandra Bullock and Nicole Kidman, PRACTICAL MAGIC 2 returns to a world steeped in moonlit mischief and powerful ancestral magic, as the Owens sisters must confront the dark curse that threatens to unravel their family once and for all in a must-see cinematic event of fun, magic and mayhem.

synopsis_lang.en: Starring Sandra Bullock and Nicole Kidman, PRACTICAL MAGIC 2 returns to a world steeped in moonlit mischief and powerful ancestral magic, as the Owens sisters must confront the dark curse that threatens to unravel their family once and for all in a must-see cinematic event of fun, magic and mayhem.
synopsis_lang.zh_hk:
月光之下，魔法甦醒！兩大金像影后珊迪娜布洛、妮歌潔曼在華納兄弟新片 《巫法闖情關：魔女秘密》(PRACTICAL MAGIC 2) 中化身奧雲姊妹，誓要與纏繞家族數代、禍及女兒愛情宿命的黑暗詛咒，決一死戰。

 

這場集驚奇魔法、刺激冒險、浪漫動人、輕鬆笑料於一身的人氣鉅獻，由《婚禮之後》金獎導演蘇珊比爾操刀，改編自Alice Hoffman原著《The Book of Magic》，即將九月躍登大銀幕，展開魔幻傳奇。

cast: Sandra Bullock, Nicole Kidman, Joey King, Lee Pace, Maisie Williams, Xolo Maridueña, Solly McLeod, Dianne Wiest, Stockard Channing
